facts.sentence: Policyholders may change their investment allocations on any policy anniversary.

facts.sentence: The first four reallocation requests per year are free.

facts.sentence: The fixed account’s guaranteed interest rate will never be less than 2%.

facts.sentence: On each policy anniversary, the index percentage change is calculated using the formula: (Ending Index Value minus Starting Index Value) divided by Starting Index Value.

facts.name: Index Crediting Formula
facts.sentence: Interest credited equals the index percentage change multiplied by the participation rate.

facts.name: Cap and Floor Limits
facts.sentence: Interest credited is subject to both a cap and a floor.

facts.sentence: If the S&P 500 Index starts at 4,000 and ends at 4,600, its gain is 15%.

facts.name: Cap Limits Indexed Returns
facts.sentence: With a 100% participation rate and a 10.5% cap, the interest credited would be capped at 10.5%.

facts.name: Floor Protection During Decline

facts.name: Market Loss Protection
facts.sentence: Market declines do not result in negative returns for the policyholder.

facts.name: Zero Interest Guarantee
facts.sentence: The worst-case scenario for the policyholder is zero interest credited due to market decline.

facts.name: Floor Protection Guarantee
facts.sentence: If the index declines by 5%, the floor protection ensures no negative return.

facts.name: Floor Protection Level

facts.name: Index Decline Protection
facts.sentence: When the index declines by 5%, the interest credited to the account is 0%.

facts.name: Market Loss Protection
facts.sentence: A market decline does not result in a loss of principal.

facts.name: Zero Interest Worst Case
facts.sentence: The worst-case scenario for the policyholder is earning 0% interest for the year.

facts.sentence: Premiums can be paid at any time.

facts.sentence: The maximum annual premium payment allowed is $50,000.

facts.sentence: An annual premium of $6,000 is recommended to maintain coverage up to age 100.

facts.sentence: Policyholders may skip premium payments provided the account value covers monthly deductions.

facts.name: Premium Payment Flexibility
facts.sentence: Account value must be sufficient to cover monthly deductions to allow skipping premium payments.

facts.sentence: A premium load of 3.5% is applied to each premium payment.

facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance (COI) is deducted monthly.

facts.sentence: Total monthly charges include both COI and administrative fees.

facts.name: Change Notice Requirement
facts.sentence: At least 60 days' advance notice is required to change death benefit options.

facts.name: Evidence of Insurability Required
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability is necessary when increasing coverage above current levels.

facts.name: Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Death Benefit' refers to the amount payable to the beneficiary upon the death of the insured during the policy term.

facts.name: Premium Due Date Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Premium Due Date' refers to the 15th day of each month.

facts.name: Grace Period Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Grace Period' refers to the 31-day period following the premium due date during which coverage continues without lapse.

facts.name: Policy Anniversary Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Policy Anniversary' refers to the same day and month as the issue date in each subsequent year.

facts.name: Grace Period Definition
facts.sentence: The grace period is a 31-day period following the premium due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Continuation
facts.sentence: Coverage continues without lapse during the grace period.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage
facts.sentence: The grace period allows continued coverage even if the premium is not paid by the due date.

facts.name: Policy Lapse After Grace Period
facts.sentence: If the premium is not paid by the end of the grace period, the policy will lapse.

facts.name: Grace Period Consequences
facts.sentence: If the premium is not paid by the end of the grace period, coverage terminates.

facts.name: Policy Anniversary Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Policy Anniversary' refers to the same day and month as the issue date in each subsequent year.

facts.name: Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: We will pay the death benefit to the beneficiary if the insured dies while this policy is in force.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of death acceptable to us must be received in order for the death benefit to be paid.

facts.name: Death Benefit Timing Condition
facts.sentence: The death benefit will only be paid if the death occurs before the policy expiry date.

facts.name: Lump Sum Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The death benefit will be paid in one lump sum unless the beneficiary chooses an alternate settlement option.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premiums are due monthly on the 15th of each month.

facts.name: Grace Period Allowance
facts.sentence: A grace period of 31 days is allowed if a premium is not paid by the due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage continues during the grace period when a premium is unpaid.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Limitation
facts.sentence: If the insured commits suicide within two years from the issue date, our liability is limited to a refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: No Additional Exclusions
facts.sentence: No other exclusions apply to this policy.

facts.name: Conversion Without Medical Proof
facts.sentence: You may convert this policy to a permanent life insurance policy without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline Constraint
facts.sentence: Conversion must occur before the earlier of the policy expiry date or the insured's 65th birthday.

facts.name: Premium Based on Attained Age
facts.sentence: The premium for the new policy will be based on the insured's attained age at conversion.

facts.name: Premium Based on Converted Coverage
facts.sentence: The premium for the new policy will be based on the amount of coverage converted.

facts.name: Premium Based on Policy Class
facts.sentence: The premium for the new policy will be based on the class of permanent policy selected.

facts.name: Conversion Age Impact
facts.sentence: The insured's attained age at conversion affects the conversion outcome.

facts.name: Coverage Amount Impact
facts.sentence: The amount of coverage converted affects the conversion outcome.

facts.name: Policy Class Impact on Conversion
facts.sentence: The class of permanent policy selected affects the conversion outcome.

facts.name: Claim Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: To claim the death benefit, the beneficiary must submit a completed claim form.

facts.name: Death Benefit Claim Requirement
facts.sentence: To claim the death benefit, the beneficiary must submit a certified copy of the death certificate.

facts.name: Death Benefit Claim Requirements
facts.sentence: To claim the death benefit, the beneficiary must submit the original policy document if available.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims should be sent to SecureLife Insurance Company.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: SecureLife Insurance Company will pay valid claims within 30 days of receiving all required documentation.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: SecureLife Insurance Company cannot contest this policy after it has been in force during the insured's lifetime for two years from the issue date.

facts.name: Misstatement Adjustment Rule
facts.sentence: If the age of the insured has been misstated, SecureLife Insurance Company will adjust the death benefit to reflect what the premiums paid would have purchased at the correct age.

facts.name: Misstatement of Insured Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If the sex of the insured has been misstated, SecureLife Insurance Company will adjust the death benefit to reflect what the premiums paid would have purchased at the correct sex.

facts.name: Age-Based Benefit Adjustment
facts.sentence: The insured’s age at the time of misstatement determines the corrected death benefit under the misstatement provision.

facts.name: Misstatement of Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: The insured’s sex at the time of misstatement determines the corrected death benefit under the misstatement provision.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Right
facts.sentence: A policyholder may assign this policy.

facts.name: Assignment Liability Limitation
facts.sentence: SecureLife Insurance Company is not responsible for the validity of any assignment.

facts.name: Assignment Binding Condition
facts.sentence: An assignment of this policy is not binding on SecureLife Insurance Company until they receive written notice at their home office.

facts.name: Chief Underwriting Officer Authorization

facts.name: Issuance of Participating Policy
facts.sentence: Guardian Family Protection Corp. issued a participating whole life insurance policy.

facts.name: Policy Identification Number
facts.sentence: The policy number is GFP-WL-2024-8847.

facts.name: Effective Coverage Start
facts.sentence: The effective date of the policy is February 1, 2024.

facts.name: Participating Whole Life Policy
facts.sentence: The policy type is participating whole life.

facts.name: Insured Person Identity
facts.sentence: The insured's name is Margaret Rose Chen.

facts.name: Insured Birth Date
facts.sentence: Margaret Rose Chen’s date of birth is July 8, 1978.

facts.name: Issue Age: 45
facts.sentence: Margaret Rose Chen’s issue age is 45.

facts.name: Standard Non-Tobacco Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Margaret Rose Chen’s risk class is standard non-tobacco.

facts.name: Face Amount: $250,000
facts.sentence: The face amount of the policy is $250,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $3,240.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payments
facts.sentence: The payment frequency for premiums is annual.

facts.name: Premiums Until Age 100
facts.sentence: The premium payment period extends until age 100.

facts.name: Maturity Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The maturity date of the policy is July 8, 2078.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: David Chen is named as the primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Marital Relationship Confirmation
facts.sentence: David Chen is married to Margaret Rose Chen.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Payout
facts.sentence: David Chen receives 100% of the death benefit payout.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Chen Family Trust is designated as the contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Payout
facts.sentence: The Chen Family Trust receives 100% of the death benefit payout if the primary beneficiary predeceases the insured.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Definition
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender Value is defined as the amount available upon policy surrender.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Definition
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender Value equals the cash value minus any outstanding loans and surrender charges.

facts.name: Dividend Definition
facts.sentence: A Dividend is a return of premium that may be declared annually by the Board of Directors.

facts.name: Dividends Based on Company Experience
facts.sentence: Dividends are based on the company’s experience.

facts.name: Paid-Up Insurance Definition
facts.sentence: Paid-Up Insurance is a reduced death benefit with no further premiums required.

facts.name: Policy Loan Definition
facts.sentence: A Policy Loan is a loan made by Guardian Family Protection Corp. using the cash value as collateral.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Growth
facts.sentence: This policy builds cash value according to the guaranteed schedule shown in the policy values table.

facts.name: Tax-Deferred Growth
facts.sentence: Cash value grows on a tax-deferred basis.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $28,450.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 20 is $71,200.

facts.name: Dividend Impact on Cash Value
facts.sentence: Actual cash value may be higher than the guaranteed amount due to dividend credits.

facts.name: Participating Policy Status
facts.sentence: This policy is a participating policy.

facts.name: Dividends Based on Mortality Experience
facts.sentence: Annual dividends may be declared based on the insurer's mortality experience.

facts.name: Dividends Based on Investment Experience
facts.sentence: Annual dividends may be declared based on the insurer's investment experience.

facts.name: Dividends Based on Expense Experience
facts.sentence: Annual dividends may be declared based on the insurer's expense experience.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Dividend Option: Cash Payment
facts.sentence: One dividend option is Cash Payment, where the dividend is paid directly to the policyholder.

facts.name: Dividend Option: Premium Reduction
facts.sentence: One dividend option is Premium Reduction, where the dividend is applied to reduce the next premium.

facts.name: Dividend Option: Accumulate at Interest
facts.sentence: One dividend option is Accumulate at Interest, where the dividend is left with the insurer to accumulate.

facts.name: Dividend Option: Paid-Up Additions
facts.sentence: One dividend option is Paid-Up Additions, where the dividend is used to purchase additional insurance.

facts.name: Selected Dividend Option: Paid-Up Additions
facts.sentence: The currently selected dividend option is Paid-Up Additions.

facts.name: Borrow Against Cash Value
facts.sentence: A policyholder may borrow against the cash value after the policy has been in force for one full year.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 90% of the current cash surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is 5% per annum.

facts.name: Annual Compounding Interest
facts.sentence: Loan interest compounds annually.

facts.name: Loan Interest Payment Option
facts.sentence: Interest on a policy loan may be paid annually.

facts.name: Loan Interest Accrual
facts.sentence: Interest on a policy loan may be added to the loan balance.

facts.name: Policy Termination Due to Debt Overhang
facts.sentence: If total indebtedness exceeds the cash value, the policy will terminate.

facts.name: Policy Termination Condition
facts.sentence: Policy termination occurs unless sufficient payment is made within 31 days of notice.

facts.name: Loan Deduction from Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Outstanding loans and accrued interest will be deducted from the death benefit.

facts.name: Loan Deduction from Cash Surrender Value
facts.sentence: Outstanding loans and accrued interest will be deducted from the cash surrender value.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Upon receipt of proof of death, the insurer will pay the beneficiary the face amount plus paid-up additions minus policy loans minus loan interest.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Upon receipt of proof of death, EFIT will pay the beneficiary the sum of the Face Amount plus Paid-Up Additions minus Policy Loans minus Loan Interest.

facts.name: Claims Settlement Timeline
facts.sentence: Payment under Section 8.1 will be made within 7 days of receiving complete claim documentation.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Election
facts.sentence: If premiums are stopped after the policy has been in force for three years, the policyholder may elect Non-Forfeiture Option CASH SURRENDER.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: CASH SURRENDER allows the policyholder to receive the cash surrender value and terminate the policy.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Election
facts.sentence: If premiums are stopped after the policy has been in force for three years, the policyholder may elect Non-Forfeiture Option REDUCED PAID-UP INSURANCE.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance
facts.sentence: REDUCED PAID-UP INSURANCE provides continued coverage for a reduced death benefit with no further premiums required.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Calculation
facts.sentence: The amount of REDUCED PAID-UP INSURANCE is based on the cash value and the insured’s attained age.

facts.name: Extended Term Insurance Eligibility
facts.sentence: If premiums are stopped after the policy has been in force for three years, the policyholder may elect Non-Forfeiture Option EXTENDED TERM INSURANCE.

facts.name: Extended Term Insurance Coverage
facts.sentence: EXTENDED TERM INSURANCE continues the full face amount for a limited period based on cash value.

facts.name: Extended Term Without Premiums
facts.sentence: No further premiums are required for EXTENDED TERM INSURANCE.

facts.name: Automatic Extended Term Application
facts.sentence: If no election is made within 60 days of lapse, Extended Term Insurance will automatically apply.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Conditions
facts.sentence: A policy may be reinstated within 3 years of lapse if evidence of insurability satisfactory to EFIT is provided.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of all overdue premiums with interest at 6% per annum.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires repayment or reinstatement of any policy loans with interest.

facts.name: Suicide Death Payout Limit
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within two years from the issue date, EFIT will pay only the premiums paid, without interest.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: If the insured's age was misstated, EFIT will adjust the face amount to match what the premium would have purchased at the correct age.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: This policy may be canceled within 30 days of receipt for a full refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation
facts.sentence: The policyholder may cancel this policy within 30 days of receiving it.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Policy
facts.sentence: A full refund of premiums paid is available upon cancellation within 30 days of receipt.

facts.name: Policy Issuer
facts.sentence: Guardian Family Protection Corp. issues this policy.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Location
facts.sentence: This policy was issued in Boston, Massachusetts.

facts.name: Policy Signing Authority
facts.sentence: The president of Guardian Family Protection Corp. signed the policy.

facts.name: Policy Signature Date
facts.sentence: The signature date on the policy is February 1, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Contestability Window
facts.sentence: The insurance company may contest this policy only within the first two years of its effective date.

facts.name: Insured Survival Requirement
facts.sentence: Contestability by the insurance company applies only when the insured person is still living.

facts.name: Policy Contestability Limit
facts.sentence: The insurance company can contest the policy only due to material misrepresentation made in the application.

facts.name: Policy Contract Identifier
facts.sentence: The contract number for the Universal Life Insurance Policy is FPS-UL-24-03391.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the Universal Life Insurance Policy is March 10, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identification
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Robert James Wilson.

facts.name: Insured Person Identity
facts.sentence: The insured person is Robert James Wilson.

facts.name: Male Insured Gender
facts.sentence: The gender of the insured is male.

facts.name: Date of Birth
facts.sentence: The date of birth of the insured is November 15, 1982.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issuance
facts.sentence: The age of the insured at the time of issuance is 41 years old.

facts.name: Policy Face Value
facts.sentence: The specified amount (face value) of the policy is $400,000.

facts.name: Planned Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The planned premium for the policy is $200 per month.

facts.name: Minimum Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The minimum premium required for the policy is $75 per month.

facts.name: Target Premium Set
facts.sentence: The target premium for the policy is $200 per month.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Level (Option A).

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the policy is Jennifer Ann Wilson.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Entitlement
facts.sentence: Jennifer Ann Wilson receives 100% of the death benefit as the primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiaries
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiaries are Robert Wilson Jr. and Emily Rose Wilson.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Robert Wilson Jr. receives 50% of the death benefit as a contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Emily Rose Wilson receives 50% of the death benefit as a contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Father-Son Relationship
facts.sentence: Robert Wilson Jr. is the son of Robert Wilson Sr.

facts.name: Incorrect Family Relationship
facts.sentence: Emily Rose Wilson is the daughter of Robert Wilson Sr.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Interest
facts.sentence: Robert Wilson Jr. holds a 50% contingent interest in the policy.

facts.name: 50% Contingent Interest
facts.sentence: Emily Rose Wilson holds a 50% contingent interest in the policy.

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: Account Value refers to the accumulation of premiums paid minus deductions for monthly charges and expenses plus interest credited.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Definition
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance (COI) refers to the monthly charge for the death benefit based on the insured's age, sex, and risk class.

facts.name: Monthly Deduction Date Schedule
facts.sentence: Monthly Deduction Date occurs on the 10th day of each month.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Terms
facts.sentence: Surrender Charge is a percentage-based fee applied when the policy is surrendered within the first 15 years.

facts.name: Minimum Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: A minimum premium payment is $75 per payment.

facts.name: Annual Premium Limit
facts.sentence: A maximum annual premium payment is $50,000 per year, subject to tax limitations.

facts.name: Flexible Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums can be paid at any time and in any amount, provided they meet the minimum and maximum limits.

facts.name: Premium Allocation After Expense Charge
facts.sentence: After payment, premiums are allocated to the Account Value after a 3% premium expense charge is deducted.

facts.name: Skip Payments Condition
facts.sentence: Payments may be skipped as long as the Account Value is sufficient to cover monthly deductions.

facts.name: Grace Period Trigger
facts.sentence: If the Account Value falls below the required level to pay monthly charges, the policy enters a 61-day grace period.

facts.name: Monthly Deductions Schedule
facts.sentence: A deduction occurs on each Monthly Deduction Date.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Deduction Timing
facts.sentence: On each Monthly Deduction Date, the Cost of Insurance charge is deducted from Account Value.

facts.name: Monthly Admin Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: On each Monthly Deduction Date, the Administrative expense charge of $8.00 per month is deducted from Account Value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Deduction
facts.sentence: On each Monthly Deduction Date, any outstanding policy loan interest is deducted from Account Value.

facts.name: COI Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance is calculated as (Specified Amount - Account Value) multiplied by Monthly COI Rate divided by 1,000.

facts.name: Guaranteed COI Rate Cap
facts.sentence: COI rates are guaranteed not to exceed the rates specified in the rate schedule attached to this policy.

facts.name: Daily Interest Crediting
facts.sentence: Interest is credited to Account Value on a daily basis.

facts.name: Daily Interest Crediting Mechanism
facts.sentence: Daily interest crediting is based on the current credited interest rate.

facts.name: Guaranteed Minimum Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum annual interest rate is 2.0%.

facts.name: Current Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The current annual interest rate is 3.5%.

facts.name: Monthly Interest Rate Adjustment
facts.sentence: The current annual interest rate is subject to change on a monthly basis.

facts.name: Variable Interest Rates by Policy Year
facts.sentence: Different credited interest rates may be declared for different policy years.

facts.name: Variable Interest Rates by Account Tier
facts.sentence: Different credited interest rates may be declared for different account value amounts.

facts.name: Current Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Option A (Level Death Benefit) is the currently selected death benefit option.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: Under Option A (Level Death Benefit), the Death Benefit equals the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Request for Increasing Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Option B (Increasing Death Benefit) is available upon request.

facts.name: Increasing Death Benefit Formula
facts.sentence: Under Option B (Increasing Death Benefit), the Death Benefit equals the Specified Amount plus the Account Value.

facts.name: Change Death Benefit Options
facts.sentence: Changing death benefit options is permitted under certain conditions.

facts.name: Insurability Requirement for Coverage Increase
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability is required when changing to a higher level of coverage.

facts.name: Processing Fee for Change
facts.sentence: A $50 processing fee is charged when changing death benefit options.

facts.name: Death Benefit Deductions
facts.sentence: Death benefit payments are made after subtracting any outstanding policy loan balances.

facts.name: Change Death Benefit Options
facts.sentence: You may change death benefit options.

facts.name: Evidence of Insurability for Coverage Increase
facts.sentence: Changing death benefit options requires evidence of insurability if increasing coverage.

facts.name: Processing Fee for Benefit Change
facts.sentence: A $50 processing fee must be paid when changing death benefit options.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Death benefit is paid minus any outstanding policy loans.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Access
facts.sentence: You may make partial withdrawals from Account Value at any time.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal
facts.sentence: The minimum partial withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: Maximum Partial Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum partial withdrawal amount is Account Value minus the amount needed to keep the policy in force.

facts.name: Withdrawal Charges (Years 1–10)
facts.sentence: Withdrawals made during years 1 through 10 incur a $25 charge per withdrawal.

facts.name: Withdrawal Charges After Year 10
facts.sentence: No withdrawal charge applies for withdrawals made in year 11 or later.

facts.name: Withdrawals Reduce Account Value
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals reduce Account Value.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction Trigger
facts.sentence: If Account Value falls below the minimum required level, the death benefit may be reduced.

facts.name: Maximum Policy Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan allowed is 90% of the current Account Value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate Formula
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is a variable rate equal to Moody's Corporate Bond Index plus 1.5%.

facts.name: Minimum Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The minimum loan interest rate is 4%.

facts.name: Annual Loan Rate Adjustment
facts.sentence: Loan interest rates are adjusted annually on January 1.

facts.name: Loan Interest Payment Option
facts.sentence: Interest on policy loans may be paid annually.

facts.name: Loan Interest Accrual
facts.sentence: Interest on policy loans may be added to the loan balance.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Outstanding policy loans reduce the death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Formula
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender Value equals Account Value minus Surrender Charge minus Outstanding Loans.

facts.name: Year 1 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: The surrender charge in year 1 is 8% of the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Formula
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender Value equals Account Value minus Surrender Charge minus Outstanding Loans.

facts.name: Year 1 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: Surrender Charge in Year 1 is 8% of the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 5 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: Surrender Charge in Year 5 is 5% of the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 10 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: Surrender Charge in Year 10 is 2% of the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Zero After Year 15
facts.sentence: Surrender Charge in Year 15 or later is 0% of the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Policy Termination on Surrender
facts.sentence: Upon surrender, the policy terminates.

facts.name: Policy Termination on Surrender
facts.sentence: Upon surrender, coverage ends.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the issue date, the insurer pays only the Account Value.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Rule
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the issue date, no interest is added to the Account Value payment.

facts.name: Contestability Period Rule
facts.sentence: The insurer may contest the policy due to material misrepresentation within 2 years of the issue date.

facts.name: Contestability Period Clause
facts.sentence: The insurer may contest the policy during the two-year contestability period while the insured is alive.

facts.name: Notification on Insufficient Funds
facts.sentence: If the Account Value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions, the insurer will send a notification.

facts.name: Grace Period Continuation
facts.sentence: When the Account Value is insufficient to pay monthly deductions, the policy remains active for 61 days.

facts.name: Policy Lapse After Grace Period
facts.sentence: If sufficient premium is not received within 61 days, the policy lapses.

facts.name: Automatic Lapse Payout
facts.sentence: Upon lapse, any Account Value exceeding surrender charges is paid to the policyholder automatically.

facts.sentence: Insured Party Gender is Female.

facts.sentence: Insured Party Class is Preferred Plus.

facts.name: Planned Annual Premium
facts.sentence: Planned Annual Premium is $12,000.

facts.sentence: Death Benefit Option is Option II.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation – Option II
facts.sentence: Option II specifies Death Benefit equals Face Amount plus Account Value.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Primary Beneficiary is Michael Thomas Foster.

facts.name: Spousal Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Michael Thomas Foster is spouse of Dr. Amanda Katherine Foster.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Ownership
facts.sentence: Primary Beneficiary Ownership Percentage is 100%.

facts.name: Secondary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Secondary Beneficiary is Foster Children's Trust.

facts.name: Secondary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: Secondary Beneficiary Ownership Percentage is 100%.

facts.name: Definition of Sub-Account
facts.sentence: A Sub-Account is a segregated investment account that invests in shares of a designated mutual fund.

facts.name: Unit Value Definition
facts.sentence: Unit Value is the value of one unit of a sub-account.

facts.name: Daily Unit Value Calculation
facts.sentence: Unit Value is calculated daily based on fund performance.

facts.name: Accumulation Units Definition
facts.sentence: Accumulation Units are units held in sub-accounts prior to any distributions.

facts.name: Daily M&E Charge
facts.sentence: Mortality and Expense Risk Charge (M&E) is charged daily.

facts.name: M&E Charge Rate
facts.sentence: Annual rate of Mortality and Expense Risk Charge (M&E) is 0.90%.

facts.name: M&E Charge Purpose
facts.sentence: Mortality and Expense Risk Charge (M&E) covers insurance risks and administrative costs.

facts.name: Premium Allocation After Load
facts.sentence: Premium payments are allocated to sub-accounts after application of premium load.

facts.name: Premium Load Application
facts.sentence: Premium payments are made after applying a premium load.

facts.name: Premium Load Charge
facts.sentence: A 5.0% premium load applies to each premium payment.

facts.name: Post-Premium Load Allocation
facts.sentence: After the premium load is applied, remaining premium payments are allocated to sub-accounts.

facts.name: Investor Instruction-Based Allocation
facts.sentence: Allocation to sub-accounts follows the investor's investment instructions.

facts.name: Available Investment Funds
facts.sentence: Available sub-accounts include the Equity Growth Fund.

facts.name: Available Sub-Accounts List
facts.sentence: Available sub-accounts include the Balanced Allocation Fund.

facts.name: Available Sub-Accounts List
facts.sentence: Available sub-accounts include the Government Bond Fund.

facts.name: Available Sub-Accounts List
facts.sentence: Available sub-accounts include the International Equity Fund.

facts.name: Money Market Fund Availability
facts.sentence: Available sub-accounts include the Money Market Fund.

facts.name: Money Market Fund Guarantee
facts.sentence: The Money Market Fund guarantees a minimum return of 1.5%.

facts.name: Available Sub-Accounts List
facts.sentence: Available sub-accounts include the Real Estate Securities Fund.

facts.name: Equity Growth Fund Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Equity Growth Fund is 40%.

facts.name: Balanced Allocation Fund Share
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Balanced Allocation Fund is 30%.

facts.name: Government Bond Fund Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Government Bond Fund is 20%.

facts.name: Money Market Fund Allocation
facts.sentence: Current allocation to the Money Market Fund is 10%.

facts.name: Allocation Change Flexibility
facts.sentence: Investors may change their allocation at any time.

facts.name: Allocation Change Methods
facts.sentence: Changes to allocation can be requested via written request.

facts.name: Allocation Change Via Portal
facts.sentence: Changes to allocation can be submitted through the online portal.

facts.name: No Fee for First 12 Changes
facts.sentence: There is no fee for up to 12 allocation changes per year.

facts.name: Allocation Change Fee
facts.sentence: A $25 fee applies for each allocation change beyond the first 12 per year.

facts.name: Mortality & Expense Risk Charge
facts.sentence: Mortality & Expense Risk Charge is 0.90% per annum of account value.

facts.name: Daily Deduction of MER Charge
facts.sentence: The Mortality & Expense Risk Charge is deducted daily.

facts.name: Administrative Fee Assessment
facts.sentence: An Administrative Charge of $15 is assessed monthly.

facts.name: Cost of Insurance Formula
facts.sentence: Cost of Insurance is calculated using the formula: (Face Amount at Risk) × (Monthly COI Rate) / 1,000.

facts.name: Face Amount at Risk Calculation
facts.sentence: Face Amount at Risk equals Death Benefit minus Account Value.

facts.name: Sub-Account Expense Ratios
facts.sentence: Each sub-account has its own annual expense ratio.

facts.name: Sub-Account Expense Ratios
facts.sentence: Sub-account expense ratios range from 0.45% to 1.25% annually.

facts.name: Expense Ratios in Prospectus
facts.sentence: Detailed expense ratios for each sub-account are provided in the prospectus.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Schedule
facts.sentence: Surrender Charges apply based on the surrender charge schedule.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 1–2
facts.sentence: For premiums paid in Year 1–2, the surrender charge is 7%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge: Years 3–4
facts.sentence: For premiums paid in Year 3–4, the surrender charge is 5%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge for Year 5–6
facts.sentence: For premiums paid in Year 5–6, the surrender charge is 3%.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Waiver After Year 6
facts.sentence: For premiums paid in Year 7 or later, the surrender charge is 0%.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Option I provides a Level Death Benefit.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Option I provides a level death benefit equal to the face amount.

facts.name: Lower Charges: Option I
facts.sentence: Option I has lower charges compared to Option II.

facts.name: No Investment Growth – Option I
facts.sentence: Option I does not allow growth from investments.

facts.name: Current Selection: Option II
facts.sentence: Option II is currently selected by the policyholder.

facts.name: Variable Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Option II provides a variable death benefit equal to the sum of the face amount and the account value.

facts.name: Higher Charges for Option II
facts.sentence: Option II incurs higher charges than Option I.

facts.name: Death Benefit Growth Under Option II
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Option II grows with the account value.

facts.name: Switch Between Death Benefit Options
facts.sentence: A policyholder may switch between Option I and Option II.

facts.name: Proof of Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Switching between options requires proof of insurability for any increase in coverage.

facts.name: Switching Options Requirements
facts.sentence: Minimum face amount requirements apply when switching options.

facts.name: Switching Fee Requirement
facts.sentence: A $50 administrative fee applies when switching between options.

facts.name: Account Value Not Guaranteed
facts.sentence: Under Option II, the account value is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Variable Death Benefit Risk
facts.sentence: Under Option II, the death benefit is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Account Value Fluctuation
facts.sentence: The account value under Option II fluctuates based on sub-account performance.

facts.name: Variable Death Benefit Fluctuation
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Option II fluctuates based on sub-account performance.

facts.name: Policy Owner Bears Investment Risk
facts.sentence: Investment risk under the policy is borne entirely by the policy owner.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Risk
facts.sentence: Poor investment performance can result in the policy lapsing.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Insufficient Funds
facts.sentence: A policy may lapse if the account value becomes insufficient to cover monthly deductions.

facts.name: Guaranteed Min. Return: 1.5%
facts.sentence: The Money Market sub-account has a guaranteed minimum interest rate of 1.5%.

facts.name: No Guaranteed Return Elsewhere
facts.sentence: Other sub-accounts besides the Money Market sub-account have no guaranteed minimum return.

facts.name: Loan Limit: 90% of Surrender Value
facts.sentence: Policy loans are limited to a maximum of 90% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The interest rate for policy loans is fixed at 5.5% per annum.

facts.name: Loan Transfer Mechanism
facts.sentence: Loan amounts are transferred to the Money Market sub-account.

facts.name: Loans Reduce Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Each loan reduces the death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals require a minimum amount of $1,000.

facts.name: Withdrawal Limit Cap
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are capped at the account value minus $5,000.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Fee
facts.sentence: A processing fee of $50 applies to partial withdrawals.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Charges
facts.sentence: Surrender charges may apply to partial withdrawals (refer to Section 3.6).

facts.name: Partial Withdrawals Reduce Face Amount
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals reduce the face amount proportionally.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: If an account's value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions for 61 consecutive days, the policy will lapse.

facts.name: Lapse Notice Timing
facts.sentence: A lapse notice will be sent at least 30 days before the policy lapses.

facts.name: Evidence of Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires payment of all back charges plus 6% interest.

facts.name: Reinstatement Loan Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years requires repayment of outstanding loans.

facts.name: Suicide Payout Limitation
facts.sentence: Suicide-related death occurring within 2 years of issue results in payout equal to premiums paid minus withdrawals.

facts.name: Suicide Payout Limit After Reinstatement
facts.sentence: Suicide-related death occurring within 2 years of reinstatement results in payout equal to premiums paid minus withdrawals.

facts.name: War Zone Military Exclusion
facts.sentence: Death during military service in a war zone is excluded if it occurs within 24 months of issue.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Rule
facts.sentence: Death resulting from operating an aircraft as pilot or crew member is excluded unless declared and approved with extra premium.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Connection
facts.sentence: This policy is issued in connection with Pinnacle Investment Life Separate Account A.

facts.name: Registered Unit Investment Trust
facts.sentence: Pinnacle Investment Life Separate Account A is a registered unit investment trust.

facts.name: Prospectus Review Requirement
facts.sentence: The prospectus for the Separate Account must be read carefully before investing.

facts.name: Prospectus Review Requirement
facts.sentence: The prospectus for the underlying funds must be read carefully before investing.

facts.name: Securities Product Classification
facts.sentence: This policy is a securities product.

facts.name: SEC Regulatory Oversight
facts.sentence: This policy is subject to SEC regulation.
